guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent: The Dockerfile build step fails when trying to install python3.11, python3.11-venv, and python3.11-distutils on Ubuntu 20.04. The error messages are: 'E: Unable to locate package python3.11', 'E: Unable to locate package python3.11-venv', and 'E: Unable to locate package python3.11-distutils'. This indicates that Ubuntu 20.04's default package repositories do not have Python 3.11 packages available. To fix this, either update the Dockerfile to install Python 3.11 using an external PPA such as deadsnakes or switch the base image to a newer Ubuntu (e.g., 22.04) that supports python3.11 natively. Note that without fixing this, the Docker build will fail and testing environment will not be created.
